title: Dental bridge
what: A bridge fills the gap left by one or more missing teeth. It rests on the neighboring teeth or on implants and is not removed.
why: When one or two teeth in a row are missing, and the neighboring teeth can be used as supports.
duration: usually 2 to 3 visits over 1 to 3 weeks
tell_doctor: If you have any decayed teeth or gum problems

prepare.title: Treatment
prepare.text: The support teeth are treated first. Sometimes a root canal is needed.

prepare.title: X-rays
prepare.text: The dentist takes an X-ray to check the roots of the support teeth.

bring: Dental X-rays, if you have them
steps: The dentist examines your teeth and takes an X-ray
With numbing, the support teeth are shaped for crowns
An impression or scan is taken
A temporary bridge is put in
Later, the permanent bridge is tried in and fixed in place
Your bite is checked, and care is explained
feel: With numbing, shaping the teeth does not hurt
For the first days, the bridge feels unusual, and the teeth may react to cold
after: Clean under the bridge with special floss or a water flosser
Do not bite very hard things
red_flags: The bridge is loose or has come off
Severe pain in a support tooth, or swollen gums

faq.q: How is a bridge worse than an implant?
faq.a: For a bridge, the neighboring teeth are shaped down. An implant does not touch them, but it needs surgery. Your dentist will help you choose.

faq.q: How long does a bridge last?
faq.a: Usually many years with good care. It is important to clean under it every day.

reminders.text: Dental bridge visit tomorrow. Eat beforehand. You will have numbing.
